verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser documents natural-language operation in several places. HyperAgent lets you 'write natural language commands instead of complex selectors' (e.g. page.ai("search for flights...")), page.extract() and the Extract API take natural-language prompts, and built-in Claude/OpenAI/Gemini/BrowserUse agents run tasks from a single API call. The MCP server also lets AI models drive it. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the natural-language commands work reliably, and a direct conversational interface (natural language is currently issued through SDK/API code rather than a chat-style console).
